attributes.explanation: Hugging Face Hub, git hosting of models and datasets

attributes.message:
During a short window inside this period (roughly 20 minutes) write operations on the Hub may fail while we migrate database infrastructure. This includes creating repositories, pushing commits and uploading files, opening or commenting on pull requests and discussions, and changing account, organization or billing settings. It affects both the UI and the API.

Reads are not affected: browsing the Hub, downloading models and datasets, and inference requests continue to work as usual. No action is needed on your end: any write that fails during the window can simply be retried afterwards.

During a brief window (approximately 5–10 minutes), uploads and commits to repositories may temporarily fail or need to be retried while we upgrade database infrastructure. This affects both the UI and the API. Downloads, reads, and browsing are not affected, and no action is needed on your end.

During a brief window (approximately 5–10 minutes), write and management operations on Spaces (creating or duplicating a Space, changing hardware or settings, pausing/restarting, and updating secrets and variables) may temporarily return a 503 error while we upgrade infrastructure. This affects both the UI and the API. Reads and already-running Spaces are not affected, and no action is needed on your end.

Our fix is now in place and this incident is resolved. Applying it caused one final short period of failed downloads between 23:00 and 23:14 UTC, as we noted could happen. Downloads from the Singapore region have been stable since, and we have added capacity to prevent this from recurring. We are sorry for the disruption.

Some file downloads from our Singapore region (ap-southeast-1) failed with 500 errors during two short periods, starting at 15:14 UTC. Downloads are normal again now. The cause is not fully resolved, so short bursts of errors can return until our fix is in place. Other CDN regions are not affected. We are sorry for the disruption.

During a short window within this period (roughly 5–10 minutes), endpoint management operations (creating, updating, pausing, or resuming endpoints) may briefly return a 503 ("temporarily unavailable due to maintenance") while we complete infrastructure upgrades. Running endpoints and inference requests are not affected, and no action is needed on your end.
Maintenance period finished. No issue detected.

During a short window inside this period (roughly 5–10 minutes) endpoint management operations (creating, updating, pausing, or resuming endpoints) may briefly return a 503 ("temporarily unavailable due to maintenance") while we complete upgrades to infrastructure. Running endpoints and inference requests are not affected, and no action is needed on your end.

Services are back to nominal operations.

Root cause confirmed to global Amazon Web Services outage.
Hugging Face platform is unavailable from most regions in the world due following a global outage from Amazon Web Services. We are working on a mitigation.
We are mitigating the issue, and services are coming back up.
